name: INV-CI-XX
desc: A compact, Intel X7425E-powered industrial computer designed for reliable edge computing and industrial automation. It features 6 Ethernet ports, optional 4G/5G connectivity, Wi-Fi 6, and flexible storage options for secure, high-performance deployments.
cpu: Intel X7425E/X7433RE/X7835RE/x7809C/i3-N305/N350 Quad Core/Octa Core with 3.9 GHz turbo frequency

storage: Up to 512 GB SSD and 64 GB eMMC
